name: composite_dual_engine
headline: The inference note's section-7 composite works in DEV and is the first 3x-in-calm configuration in the panel to pass all seven gates - dev_1990 Sharpe 0.543, CAGR 11.41% vs SPY 8.34%, maxDD -25.6%, 5.5 changes/yr, 42% of days in cash, 23.6% of days actually at 3x, average leverage when invested 1.81x - but it does NOT beat vix_vrp_v2 (0.678 / -19.8%); the ablations say hysteresis (+0.083 Sharpe) is what makes it work, the pre-registered shock exit is Sharpe-negative on its own (-0.044), and it sits out the entire 2009 recovery in cash.
biggest_weakness: It misses V-bottoms completely: 207 of 207 days of the 2009 recovery in cash (+0.1% vs SPY +67.4%). Both re-entry channels fail at once - VIX's 2009 minimum was 19.47 against a STRESSED-exit level of 19.32 (a 0.15-point miss), and the strict dissipation burst cannot fire when implied vol peaks with the price low (09-Mar-2009: VIX 49.7 vs a 30-day max of 52.6, needing <=39.5). Raising v_high does not buy participation (23.5/24/26 -> -0.2%/-0.2%/-2.1%) and destroys the 2000-02 protection that G3 rests on. Secondary: the 3x tier is era-concentrated (almost all 3x days fall in 1992-96 and 2004-07; zero in 1997-2000 and 2003), and v_high is the one fragile axis - the sole G6 perturbation failure and an 8-point maxDD swing per VIX point.
bugs_in_shared_code: None. engine.py, features.py, dev_harness.py and gate_check.py behaved as documented across ~1,500 signal evaluations; lookahead_check max_abs_diff 0.0 at all five cut-offs. Two non-bug notes for the coordinator: (i) dev_harness.plateau rounds integer perturbations, so out_days/min_hold +/-15% are asymmetric steps (10 -> 8 and 12), worth knowing when reading G6; (ii) the previous designer's own helper dev_results/composite_dual_engine_show.py crashes on eras whose Sharpe is None (the all-cash pre-1990 eras) - replaced by composite_dual_engine_show2.py inside this lens's own files, not a shared-code defect.
